title: College / AYA:
format: 16:9 · 1920×1080 for V1 (client ask). 9:16 comes later as a separate version.
headline: A college student says no to dinner with friends. The real reason is a past-due bill, a treatment calendar and an empty fridge.
story: Lila studies alone in a dim room. Her phone lights up: friends want burgers. She looks at the past-due bill on her desk and the appointments on her calendar, and types “Can't tonight. Have to study.” She opens a near-empty fridge, sits back down, and looks at us.

This is a Side Effects short. The client wants this series serious and heavy, “a little shaken by the gravity of them.” The hopeful-only rule does not apply here. The only voice is one narrator line at the end.
do: Open on her at the desk on frame 1. Natural room sound only.
Put both text messages on screen exactly as the client wrote them.
Use the straight-on look to camera (C031). The client asked for it by name.
Turn the grade cold when she sets the phone down.
Hold 1 s of silence after the VO line before the cards.
dont: Do not change a word of the texts or the VO.
No real phone number or real contact name on the phone.
No bright narrator, no upbeat music, no sad-piano cliché.
No logo before the end cards. No lower-thirds.

bp_intro: Source clips are the Day 2 proxies A002_12042143_C020 to A002_12042234_C042 (1920×1080, 23.976 fps). There is no dialogue. Clip times are seconds inside each proxy, from visual.json and from frames pulled from the real files. Frames are ungraded RAW, so they look flat.

rows.frame_alt: Lila alone at a small desk by the window, writing
rows.visual: Wide: Lila at her desk by the window, laptop open, writing. Dim room. Start on frame 1 (C021 9.1–27.2 s). Then cut closer: she writes, phone and water glass beside her (C025 21.9–29.2 s).
rows.motion: Picture only. Nothing written on screen.

rows.visual: Her hands hold the phone over the notebook (C027 8.9–26.7 s). Then the phone with a message open (C029 9.7–29.2 s). Match the graphic to the phone angle.
rows.motion: Incoming text as a graphic on the phone screen: <q>Dinner tonight? We're meeting up for burgers! You coming?</q> Sender: a first name only (brief: “Maya”). Never a real contact or number.

rows.frame_alt: Hands hold a PAST DUE bill in front of the laptop
rows.visual: She holds the bill: it is stamped PAST DUE (C035 25.4–33.9 s; visual.json wrongly says “POSTAGE”). Then the October 2026 wall calendar (C022 4.9–14.7 s). Then two appointment cards (C024 11.5–15.4 s).
rows.motion: Fix the appointment-card dates in post if Nick asks (the crew filmed them steady for this). Check on scrub: visual.json reads one card as “WED OCT 1”, but 1 Oct 2026 is a Thursday.

rows.visual: She types on the phone (C026 12.4–37.2 s). Then she puts the phone down (C028 51.5–68.7 s). Grade turns cold on this cut.
rows.motion: Outgoing text as a graphic: <q>Can't tonight. Have to study.</q>
rows.sfx: Soft typing taps. Phone set down on the desk.
rows.music: Low, cold tone starts. No melody.

rows.visual: Slow pull-out feel: she walks into the kitchen (C041 8.1–24.2 s) and opens the fridge. Almost empty, lit by her phone (C041 24.2–32.4 s). Alternate take: C042 25.6–34.2 s.

She sits back down and looks straight into the lens with a defeated face (C031 7.1–21.3 s; the crew directed “look straight into the camera”). If she tears up on another take, use it. Alternate: C032 5.8–17.3 s. Hold 1 s after the VO ends.

voice.quote: She's trying to keep up with classes, treatment and dollars that don't stretch far enough… her whole future was ahead of her.
voice.src: Client script, College Student/AYA Scene, VO

rows.music: Very low. Out with the VO.

rows.visual: Black 1 s. Art card 1, 3 s. Art card 2, 3 s. Same style as the Utilities cut.
rows.motion: Art card 1: <q>The side effects of cancer aren't always medical.</q> Art card 2: the Family Reach 30 Year logo, new brand only.
